note: Verified against live endpoints; field lists and metadata only, no records. Not yet in the catalog.

sources.title: Below Market Rate (BMR) Housing

ami: AMI tier text e.g. '65% AMI'

sources.title: Comprehensive Parks (Public View)

sources.title: Impervious Surface Land Connecticut 2023

sources.title: Affordable Housing by Town 2011–2023 (Affordable Housing Appeals List)

sources.title: CTtransit GTFS static schedule (statewide, incl. New Haven division)
sources.license: CTtransit GTFS Data Terms of Use / license agreement (2013), free use with attribution terms
sources.updateFrequency: each service change (feed files dated 2026-09-17; calendar to 2027-01-09)
sources.recordDescription: A GTFS feed: stops.txt row = one bus stop, routes.txt row = one route, trips.txt = one scheduled trip, stop_times.txt = one scheduled stop visit.
keyFields: agency_id (2 = 'CTTransit- New Haven'; 29 routes, e.g. 201,204,206,212…282, USS)
stop_id / stop_code (9,625 stops statewide; ~1,629 inside New Haven bbox)
sources.catalogFit: new concept needed: transit-schedule (GTFS) — Transit Agency, Transit Stop, Transit Route, Scheduled Trip, Stop Time, Service Calendar, Route Shape; adopt GTFS Schedule as a kind 'standard' source
sources.notes: Single zip covers Hartford, New Haven, Stamford, New Britain, Waterbury-Meriden, CTfastrak (7 agency rows). Files: agency, calendar, calendar_dates, routes, shapes, stop_times, stops, trips (no feed_info). Columns: stops=stop_id,stop_code,stop_name,stop_lat,stop_lon,zone_id,stop_url,location_type,parent_station,stop_timezone,wheelchair_boarding; routes=route_id,agency_id,route_short_name,route_long_name,route_desc,route_type,route_url,route_color,route_text_color; trips=trip_id,route_id,service_id,trip_headsign,trip_short_name,direction_id,block_id,shape_id,wheelchair_accessible,bikes_allowed (trips.txt has a UTF-8 BOM); stop_times=trip_id,stop_sequence,stop_id,arrival_time,departure_time,stop_headsign,pickup_type,drop_off_type,shape_dist_traveled,timepoint; calendar=service_id,monday..sunday,start_date,end_date; calendar_dates=service_id,date,exception_type; shapes=shape_id,shape_pt_sequence,shape_pt_lat,shape_pt_lon,shape_dist_traveled. 11.4 MB zip; 737k stop_times. data.ct.gov v75z-3e8f is a stale 2014 link to this feed. City also publishes New_Haven_Bus_Stops / New_Haven_Bus_Routes FeatureServers at gis.newhavenct.gov/server/rest/services/Hosted (derived from GTFS).

sources.title: CTtransit GTFS-realtime: vehicle positions, trip updates, alerts
sources.license: CTtransit GTFS Data Terms of Use

keyFields: trip.trip_id, trip.route_id (join to GTFS static trips/routes)
sources.catalogFit: new concept needed: transit-realtime — Vehicle Position, Trip Update, Service Alert (GTFS-realtime standard)
sources.notes: NO KEY required — verified HTTP 200 for VehiclePositions.json (157 KB, statewide fleet), TripUpdates.pb (595 KB), Alerts.json. Each also offered as JSON: replace .pb with .json (Vehicle/VehiclePositions.json, TripUpdate/TripUpdates.json, Alert/Alerts.json). Statewide; filter by route_id of agency 2 for New Haven. JSON variant is a protobuf-to-JSON dump (nulls for absent oneofs).

Files: agency, calendar, feed_info, routes, shapes, stop_times, stops, trips. Station codes NHV/STS differ from Metro-North (149/151) and Hartford Line ids — cross-feed station join must be by coordinates/name.

Station metadata API: https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/mdapi/prod/webapi/stations/8465705.json?expand=details,products,sensors (PORTS affiliation; sensors include microwave WL, tsunami WL). Also feeds High Tide Flooding outlook. NWS weather for New Haven: api.weather.gov gridpoint OKX/66,75, obs station KHVN (Tweed) — public, needs User-Agent.

sources.title: EPA AirNow current monitor data (ArcGIS) — New Haven Criscuolo Park 09-009-0027
sources.license: US government public data; preliminary, unvalidated

sources.catalogFit: new concept needed: environmental-observation — Air Monitoring Site, Air Quality Observation, AQI (EPA AQS site/parameter codes as 'standard')
sources.notes: 126,668 rows nationally (recent hours); 28 for AQSID 090090027. No key. Raw hourly files also public without key: https://files.airnowtech.org/airnow/today/HourlyData_YYYYMMDDHH.dat (pipe-delimited: date|time|AQSID|site|gmtoffset|parameter|unit|value|agency; New Haven site reports BARPR, BC, CO, NO, NO2, O3, PM, SO2, met) and Monitoring_Site_Locations_V2.dat (22 fields). AirNow API (airnowapi.org) needs a key (401). EPA AQS validated data API needs email+key (aqs.epa.gov/data/api; test credentials work for list endpoints); AQS pre-generated annual CSVs are public.

sources.title: USGS 01196573 Quinnipiac River at Fair Haven — continuous water quality
sources.license: US government public domain; no key (key optional for higher rate)
sources.recordDescription: One latest value of one time series (parameter) at the monitoring location.

sources.catalogFit: new concept needed: environmental-observation — Monitoring Location, Time Series, Observation (OGC API–Features / SensorThings; USGS parameter codes as code list)
sources.notes: Only active USGS IV site found in the New Haven bbox (-73.02,41.25,-72.85,41.40) — no active streamflow gauge on Mill/West rivers. Legacy endpoint also works: https://waterservices.usgs.gov/nwis/iv/?format=json&sites=01196573. monitoring-locations collection carries ~40 site attributes (county_code, hydrologic_unit_code, site_type…).

sources.title: Water Quality Portal (EPA/USGS/NWQMC) — New Haven area stations & results

OrganizationIdentifier (CT_DEP01_WQX = CT DEEP, 21CTBCH = CT beach program, 1CTDPHBM)

sources.notes: 135 stations in bbox (STORET); 7,860 results since 2020 across 36 sites (incl. 714 NWIS). Mill/West/Quinnipiac DEEP ambient sites present; 21CTBCH beach sites present but have 0 results since 2020 — current beach closure data not here. Result fields count 77 (narrowResult profile).

sources.title: SeeClickFix issues (New Haven 311)
sources.publisher: City of New Haven via SeeClickFix (CivicPlus)
sources.license: SeeClickFix Terms of Use (no open license stated)
sources.recordDescription: One resident-reported service request (pothole, missed trash, illegal dumping...) with location, status and request type.
keyFields: request_type.id / request_type.title / request_type.organization: category and responsible org (e.g. 'New Haven', 'Public Health', 'New Haven Parking Authority')
lat/lng, address: location (join to ward/police district/tract by point-in-polygon)
sources.catalogFit: Issue Report (rows); request_type -> Report Category; request_type.organization -> Civic Body; transitions/comments -> Report Update
sources.notes: place_url=new-haven verified; first unfiltered page reported 8,326 entries (default status filter). After ~5 list calls Cloudflare returned 403 on /issues list for the rest of the session (single-issue and request_types/{id} still 200) - poll politely. request_types/{id} returns the intake questions (custom per-category fields). Top categories in a 100-issue sample: Illegal Dumping, Missed Trash/Recycling, Parking Violation, Parks Request, Sidewalks and Curb damage, Tree Requests.

sources.title: SeeClickFix Open311 GeoReport v2 (New Haven services and requests)

service_request_id: same id as SeeClickFix v2 issue id
sources.catalogFit: Report Category (services.json); Issue Report (requests.json) - this is the Open311 standard the concepts were modeled on
sources.notes: Standard-conformant and NOT blocked when the v2 list endpoint was. Location-scoped by lat/long rather than place; returns 20 most recent by default. Better first choice for a generic Open311 reader; v2 adds request_type questions and transitions.

sources.title: Board of Alders meetings and agenda items (Legistar events)

sources.notes: 89 events since 2026-01-01. Votes: /eventitems/{id}/votes returns [] and EventItemTally/RollCallFlag/PassedFlag are null/0 on all items in 4 recent full-Board meetings; matter histories show action names ('Passed') without tallies. Individual alder votes are not published via the API.

sources.catalogFit: Legislative Body (bodies); Elected Official (persons via officerecords)
